description_en: This operation sends messages to different phone numbers using a single template, with different signatures and template variables for each recipient
description_zh: 调用此接口可以给不同的手机号码，发送不同签名、同一个模板（可以是不同模板变量）的短信
kebab_example: aliyun dysmsapi send-batch-sms --phone-number-json '["1590000****","1350000****"]' --sign-name-json '["阿里云","阿里巴巴"]' --template-code SMS_152550000 --template-param-json '[{"name":"TemplateParamJson"},{"name":"TemplateParamJson"}]' --sms-up-extend-code-json '["90999","90998"]' --out-id abcdefg --api-version 2017-05-25 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SendBatchSms

parameters.help_en:
The recipient phone numbers. Format:

For domestic SMS: Phone numbers with or without a country code such as `+`, `+86`, `0086`, or `86`. Example: `1590000****`.

For international SMS: The country code followed by the phone number. Example: `852000012****`.

For time-sensitive messages like verification codes, use the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/419273.html operation to send messages individually
parameters.help_zh:
接收短信的手机号码。手机号码格式：

国内短信：+/+86/0086/86或无任何前缀的手机号码，例如1590000\\。
国际/港澳台消息：国际区号+号码，例如852000012\\。

时效要求高的短信，如验证码类型短信，请使用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/419273.html接口单条发送
parameters.name: phone_number_json

parameters.help_en:
The signature names. The number of signatures must match the number of phone numbers.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/419282.html operation or check the Short Message Service console (https://dysms.console.aliyun.com/domestic/text/sign) to find approved signatures. You must use an approved signature.

The system uses the selected signature to send SMS messages
parameters.help_zh:
短信签名名称，签名数量需与手机号码数量一致。

您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/419282.html接口查询当前账号已申请的签名或在短信服务控制台 (https://dysms.console.aliyun.com/domestic/text/sign)查看已审核通过的签名，必须使用审核通过的签名发送短信。


系统会根据您选择的签名执行短信发送任务
parameters.name: sign_name_json

parameters.help_en:
The message template code. You cannot use templates for domestic SMS and international SMS interchangeably.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/419288.html operation or check the Short Message Service console (https://dysms.console.aliyun.com/domestic/text/template) to find approved template codes. You must use an approved template code
parameters.help_zh:
短信模板Code。国内短信模板和国际短信模板不可以混用。

您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/419288.html接口查询当前账号已申请的模板或在短信服务控制台 (https://dysms.console.aliyun.com/domestic/text/template)查看模板列表，必须使用已审核通过的模板Code发送短信
parameters.name: template_code

parameters.help_en:
The actual values for the template variables. This parameter is required if the template contains variables.

The number of template variable sets must match the number of phone numbers and signatures. The elements in the PhoneNumberJson, SignNameJson, and TemplateParamJson arrays must correspond by index to ensure each message is sent with the correct signature and variable values.

If you need to include a line break in the JSON string, follow the standard JSON format
parameters.help_zh:
短信模板变量对应的实际值。当您选择的模板内含有变量时，此参数必填。

模板变量值的个数必须与手机号码、签名的个数相同、内容一一对应，表示向指定手机号码中发对应签名的短信，且短信模板中的变量参数替换为对应的值。
如果JSON中需要带换行符，请参照标准的JSON协议处理
parameters.name: template_param_json

parameters.help_en:
A JSON array of MO SMS extension codes.

You can leave this parameter empty if you have no special requirements
parameters.help_zh:
上行短信扩展码，JSON数组格式。

无特殊需要可忽略此字段
parameters.name: sms_up_extend_code_json

parameters.help_en:
An external business ID. It must be a string of fewer than 256 characters.

You can leave this parameter empty if you have no special requirements
parameters.help_zh:
外部流水扩展字段，长度小于256的字符串。

无特殊需要可忽略此字段
parameters.name: out_id
